lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Two days later. A nebula bank the charts call Quiet Water.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Behold. One alien launcher: bolted, wired, and only slightly on fire.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: And these are our own survey charges. Retune the fuses and they stop mapping rock. They burn out the engines of whatever bumps into them.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: I went through Finch's last logs. Weave ships hunt by heat and motion. A cold charge sitting still is invisible to them.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Then let's make it count. Teo's already in Sparrow.

lines.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines.text: Sparrow's out of the cradle. First real sortie. I'm flying this one for Nanda, Sefa and Dov.

lines.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines.text: The passage ahead is narrow. One way in, one way out. Perfect place for an ambush.

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: Good. Let's be the ones setting it.
